##: Upstream ships an Advanced Installer bootstrapper (fxsound_setup.exe) wrapping fxsound.x64.msi + fxsound1.cab and installing the fxvad virtual audio driver. Non-portable: 'fxsound_setup.exe /extract <dir>' unpacks the x86 MSI, the x64 MSI and the shared cab, then msiexec installs per-machine (ALLUSERS=1) into 'C:\Program Files\FxSound LLC\FxSound'.
description: Real-time audio enhancement for Windows - graphic equalizer, effects and presets applied system-wide to playback.
notes: Installs a virtual audio device driver (fxvad) under 'C:\Program Files\FxSound LLC\FxSound' - install from an elevated (Administrator) terminal.
The x64 MSI + cab are kept in the app directory so 'scoop uninstall fxsound' can run 'msiexec /x'; the unused x86 MSI is deleted after install.
The installed app ships its own 'updater.exe'. Letting it update in place makes the manifest version drift from what is actually installed; update through scoop instead.

script: if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { abort "fxsound_setup /extract failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0, 1641, 3010)) { abort "msiexec /i failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
if ($p.ExitCode -notin @(0, 1641, 3010)) { abort "msiexec /x failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
